note: Simulated at Polymarket prices; no money placed. Units only.

edge.label: Value
edge.rule: Bets when the 40/60 model-market blend clears a 4-point edge and model and market differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the blended edge is bigger; never at odds above 3.0 or a price more than 3 points above the market's margin-free chance

agree.label: Agreement
agree.rule: Bets the model's pick when the market also makes it the favourite and the price is no worse than the model's chance and the two differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the model's edge is bigger; never at odds above 3.0 or a price more than 3 points above the market's margin-free chance

model_value.label: Model value
model_value.rule: Bets the model's pick when the price is below the model's chance, whichever team the market favours, if model and market differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the model's edge is bigger; never at odds above 3.0 or a price more than 3 points above the market's margin-free chance

player_model.label: Player model
player_model.rule: Bets the player-rating model's pick (League games; OW2, Dota 2, VALORANT and CS2 series) when the price is below its chance, if model and market differ by 30 points or less; bets more when its edge is bigger; never at odds above 3.0 or a price more than 3 points above the market's margin-free chance

favourite.label: Market favourite (control)
favourite.rule: Bets the market favourite at a flat 1 unit; the control the others must beat; never at odds above 3.0 or a price more than 3 points above the market's margin-free chance
